integrity: The proof reduces the problem to integer partitions of excess individuals, derives extremal quadratic bounds for the no-reversal region, and exhaustively enumerates the sharp layer using exact integer arithmetic. The same ordering is independently checked for both common Simpson concentration formulas.
scientific_limitations: The theorem fixes species richness and total abundance, requires strictly positive integer species counts, and compares Berger–Parker dominance with Simpson concentration. It is a finite-resolution ranking theorem, not a recommendation that either index should replace multidimensional ecological assessment.
title: Eight excess individuals are the sharp Berger–Parker–Simpson reversal boundary
